Name: Sprite-Accurate Demetrius
Author: BadMoonBeast
Description:
[i]Hey, Beast here. This is a very simple mod to bring Demetrius's portrait in line with his sprite. Let me know if you encounter any issues.

[/i][b]Includes:[/b]
[list]
[*]New 1.6 Portrait and Winter outfit
[/list]
﻿If you'd like a seasonal version, it's now available as part of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23918]this Diverse Stardew Valley addon[/url]!﻿
[b]Please note[/b] that you will require [b]both[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order for this mod to work.

Manifest.Name: Sprite-Accurate Demetrius
Manifest.Description: Makes Demetrius's portrait match his sprite.
